title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons Regularization of Services Act 2015

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons Regularization of Services Act 2015
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
An
act to provide for the regularization of the services of certain Medical
Officers and Dental Surgeons appointed on adhoc and
contract basis in various Government hospitals of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical
Officers and Dental Surgeons (Regularization of Services) Act, 2015.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons Regularization of Services Act 2015
sections.description:
Definitions

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
An
act to provide for the regularization of the services of certain Medical
Officers and Dental Surgeons appointed on adhoc and
contract basis in various Government hospitals of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
2. Definitions.---(1) In this Act, unless
the context otherwise requires,-
(a) Commission
means the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission;
(b) Government
means the Government of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa;
(c) law or rules means the law or rules for the time being in
force governing the selection and appointment of civil servants;
(d) Medical
Officers and Dental Surgeons mean Medical Officers (BS-17) (General Cadre) and
Dental Surgeons (BS-17) appointed by Government on Adhoc
and Contract basis against vacant posts in various Government Hospitals of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa from 19-04-2011 till 13-12-2013;
and
(e) post means a post of the Medical Officer and Dental Surgeon
in various Government Hospitals of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
and is required to be filled on the recommendation of Commission.
(2) The expressions Adhoc appointment or Contract appointment shall have the
same meaning as respectively assigned to them in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Civil Servants Act, 1973 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XVIII of 1973).

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons Regularization of Services Act 2015
sections.description:
Regularization of services of certain Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
An
act to provide for the regularization of the services of certain Medical
Officers and Dental Surgeons appointed on adhoc and
contract basis in various Government hospitals of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
3. Regularization of services of certain Medical Officers and Dental
Surgeons.---(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law or
rules, all Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons who were holding the posts till
the commencement of this Act, shall be deemed to have been validly appointed to
the posts on regular basis from the date of commencement of this Act;
Provided that:
(a) such Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons were appointed
against those posts which fall within the ambit of the Commission;
(b) the services of such Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons
shall be deemed to have been regularized only on the publication of their names
in the Official Gazette;
(c) such Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons possess the
qualification and experience prescribed for the posts to which they appointed
on regular basis;
(d) the candidates recommended by the Commission till the date
of commencement of this Act shall have the first right for appointment against
the post instead of Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons to be regularized
under this Act; and
(e) such Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons were appointed
after observance of all codal formalities/criteria.

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons Regularization of Services Act 2015
sections.description:
Determination of seniority

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
An
act to provide for the regularization of the services of certain Medical
Officers and Dental Surgeons appointed on adhoc and
contract basis in various Government hospitals of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
4. Determination of seniority.---(1) The Medical Officers and
Dental Surgeons whose services are regularized under this Act shall rank junior
to all other Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons belonging to the same service
or cadre, as the case may be, on regular basis on the commencement of this Act,
and shall rank junior to such other Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons, if
any, who, in pursuance of the recommendation of the Commission made before the
commencement of this Act, are to be appointed to the respective service or
cadre, irrespective of their actual date of appointment.
(2) The seniority interse of the Medical Officers and Dental Surgeons, whose
services are regularized under this Act within the same service, shall be
determined on the basis of their continuous officiating in such service:
Provided that if
the date of continuous officiating in the case of two or more Medical Officers
and Dental Surgeons is the same, the Medical Officer and Dental Surgeon older
in age shall rank senior to the younger one.

Overriding effect

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MEDICAL OFFICERS AND DENTAL SURGEONS (REGULARIZATION
OF SERVICES) ACT, 2015
An
act to provide for the regularization of the services of certain Medical
Officers and Dental Surgeons appointed on adhoc and
contract basis in various Government hospitals of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
5. Overriding effect.---Notwithstanding
anything to the contrary contained in any other law or rules, the provisions of
this Act shall have an overriding effect and the provisions of any such law or
rules to the extent of inconsistency to this Act shall cease to have effect.
